title: Debt Snowball vs Avalanche: The $215 Truth (Which Actually Works)
description:
Snowball vs avalanche — the $215 question that decides if you actually pay off debt. The math vs the psychology, in 70 seconds.

The avalanche (highest interest first) wins the math by $215 on a $10,636 balance — 27 vs 28 months, $2,838 vs $3,053 in interest. But a Kellogg study of 6,000 debt settlement clients found the people who finished were the ones who closed accounts early. The snowball closes its first account in month 4; the avalanche closes nothing until month 10.

The best method isn't the one with the best math. It's the one you don't quit.
